items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Baby Hall, he's another drummer probably.

ctx.x: Yeah. And a boyfriend of mine that knew her before he knew me, he's the one who bought the ring, you see, on her hand and the marriage license. And we got married. And we got married. In two, three months afterwards. After you met her. After I met her. Three months afterwards. And we've been going ever since. Now when we got here in Chicago, I had decided to stay here in Chicago about nine weeks. And then I thought I would go to New York and stay about nine weeks because her father wanted me to open business. I…
Yes, I knew him. I knew him. He played just not in our country.
